name: mirage
text: On it, continuously. Just done: (1) the maker now uses the entire wallet (limits were $75/$80; now it's whatever cash is free, $1 reserve), (2) from 49,000 resolved real outcomes I found why parlays lose: favorite-ish legs (60-75% chance) win 2-3% more often than their odds say and longshot legs (5-35%) win about 10% less, and parlays multiply that, so parlays of mid/high legs lose to buyers while parlays of longshot legs favor us. The engine now corrects every leg for that before pricing, so it quotes parlays of longshot legs more aggressively and charges more on favorite-heavy ones. Restarting the engine with it now (once); I'll report the first results in about 20 minutes.
